title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: Look at the 'item' column in the DataFrame. Each row represents a fruit item available at a specific store location. Your task is to find out which fruit appears most frequently across all rows.

title: Using $$\operatorname{value_{counts}}\left(\right)$$
text: The function $$\operatorname{value_{counts}}\left(\right)$$ can be used to count the occurrences of each unique value in a column. Apply this function to the 'item' column to see how many times each fruit appears.

title: Selecting the Most Frequent Item
text: After using $$\operatorname{value_{counts}}\left(\right)$$, how can you select the item that appears the most?
